nodes.name: One-pot wet-chemical synthesis
nodes.procedure: 9.5 mg Pd(acac)2, 5.5 mg Rh6(CO)16, 5.5 mg Fe3(CO)12, 5.0 mg Mn2(CO)10, 35 mg Mo(CO)6 and 25 mg AA was ultrasonically dispersed in 6.0 mL OAm to form the precursor solution. Afterwards, an oil bath at 150°C was used to heat the mixture for eight hours. The HEM product was collected after centrifugation and four washes with a mixed solution of cyclohexane, acetone, and ethanol.

nodes.name: Carbon-supported catalyst preparation
nodes.procedure: 4 mg PdRhMoFeMn HEAs dissolved in 4 ml cyclohexane were mixed with 16 mg Ketjen carbon dissolved in 16 ml cyclohexane, followed by sonicating for 2 hours. After magnetically stirring overnight, the loaded sample obtained by centrifugation was redispersed in 20 ml acetic acid and heated at 70°C for 120 min to clean the organic residues on the surface of PdRhMoFeMn HEAs. Then, the catalyst was obtained via centrifugation, followed by three washes with ethanol, and dried in a vacuum at 50°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: Low-magnification HAADF-STEM shows graphene-like 2D nanosheets with abundant porous nanochannels.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Low-magnification high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) and TEM images in Fig. 1b and Supplementary Fig. 3 show that the obtained products are dominated by graphene-like 2D nanosheets with abundant porous nanochannels.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM confirms ultrathin PdRhMoFeMn HEMs with curvature and lattice fringes of 0.228 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image confirms that PdRhMoFeMn HEMs are ultrathin and possess a certain curvature (Fig. 1c).

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM characterizes thickness of ~1 nm, affirming sub-nanometric metallenes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The thickness of PdRhMoFeMn HEMs was determined to be six atomic layers from the edge seen in aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM (Fig. 1d), in good conformity with a thickness of ~1 nm characterized by AFM atomic force microscopy (AFM).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows face-centered cubic (fcc) configuration without phase segregation, analogous to pure Pd with weakened and broadened peaks due to lattice distortion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern in Fig. 1e shows that PdRhMoFeMn HEMs possess a face-centered cubic (fcc) configuration without phase segregation, which is analogous to that of pure Pd.
The Pd/Rh/Mo/Fe/Mn ratio was determined by the SEM energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDS) to be 23.52/20.97/17.42/16.58/21.51 (Fig. 1f).
Similar results were obtained from the inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES) measurement (Pd/Rh/Mo/Fe/Mn=23.37/19.53/18.07/17.35/21.68) (Supplementary Table 1).

nodes.characterization_summary: Aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM-EDS elemental mappings show homogeneous distribution of all elements throughout the HEMs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM-EDS elemental mappings show the homogenous distribution of all elements throughout the HEMs (Fig. 1i).

nodes.characterization_summary: XANES spectra show Pd and Rh white line intensities closer to metal foils than oxides, indicating mainly metallic state; EXAFS shows Pd-M and Rh-M peaks at ~2.75 Å; WT-EXAFS confirms alloy formation with varied coordination environment.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 2a, c, the X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra exhibit that the white line intensities of Pd and Rh in PdRhMoFeMn HEMs are closer to Pd and Rh foils and far away from the PdO and Rh2O3 reference samples.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface chemical composition of PdRhMoFeMn HEMs was further investigated with X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XANES shows unchanged Pd electronic structure in acid, increased electron density on Rh in acid, and on both Pd/Rh in alkaline/neutral; operando EXAFS shows stable Rh-M coordination and Pd-M reconstruction in alkaline/neutral.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To deeply shed light on the role of each active site and the corresponding catalytic reaction mechanism, the operando XAS measurements were performed on the PdRhMoFeMn HEM catalyst using a tailor-made cell in the three electrolytes representing universal pH.
